classification.reason: Request is a scientific goal or asks for planning without a concrete workflow.

plan.goal: Generate one small (~60-residue) soluble de novo protein candidate using ESM3 co-generation, validate with sequence QC and independent AF3-class structure prediction, then rank the single candidate.
assumptions: Target length fixed at 60 residues as a compact soluble default; no user-specified length or fold class was provided, so generation is unconditional from a poly-Ala seed.
Poly-alanine seed (60 residues) is a standard ESM3 de novo prior that yields a structurally plausible backbone without biasing toward a known fold.
temperature=0.7 increases sequence diversity relative to the default 0.5 while remaining below the high-noise regime; num_steps=20 (default) balances quality and speed for a single candidate pass.
Solubility proxy: sequence_analysis charge, pI, and liability count at pH 7.4 used as QC signal; no host-specific expression context applied.

protenix_v2 provides orthogonal AF3-class pLDDT/pTM evidence; MSA disabled (msa_backend=none, use_msa=false) because a de novo sequence has no meaningful homologs and remote MSA would be uninformative.
n_sample=1 and a single seed satisfy the at-most-one-candidate scope without sharding overhead.
The workflow runtime serialises the ESM3 output sequence into a single-chain Protenix-format input JSON and exposes its path as outputs.esm3_gen.protenix_input_json.
rank_designs top_k=1 deterministically selects the sole candidate; ranking weights are default (pLDDT-primary) absent user-supplied fitness criteria.
